name: Chromoblastomycosis
advice: Long treatment (6–12 months or more) is needed — do not stop when lesions flatten. LFT at baseline and monthly; tell us about other medicines (itraconazole interacts with many drugs). Small lesions may be removed by cryotherapy or excision; local heat packs help.

rx.instr: Until clinical + KOH/culture cure; take with a full meal
Alternative, or combined with itraconazole in resistant cases; LFT monthly
